import json, sys
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp')
from harness import *

failures=[]
def check(name, got, want):
    if got != want:
        failures.append(name); print('FAIL',name); print('  got ',json.dumps(got,sort_keys=True)[:400]); print('  want',json.dumps(want,sort_keys=True)[:400])
    else: print('ok  ',name)

def base(**kw):
    doc={"seed":"s","definitions":[],"timeout_ms":10,"cases":[],"events":[],"channels":[]}
    doc.update(kw); return doc

def sent_of(doc):
    return run(json.dumps(doc))['cases'][0]['sent']

# --- random_string substitution in a frame data template
tok = rand_token('s','case/0/frame/0/data',0)
doc = base(cases=[{"name":"a","frames":[{"Type":"data","data_to_transfered":"x<<random_string>>y","End_Stream":True}],"expect":{"method":"GET","target":"/","host":"h"}}])
check('random frame data', sent_of(doc), fp(b'x'+tok.encode()+b'y'))

# --- occurrences numbered per template, coordinate per header pair
tok0 = rand_token('s','case/0/frame/0/h/0/n',0)
tok1 = rand_token('s','case/0/frame/0/h/0/v',0)
tok2 = rand_token('s','case/0/frame/0/h/0/n',1)
doc = base(cases=[{"name":"a","frames":[{"Type":"headers","data_to_transfered":[["<<random_string>><<random_string>>","<<random_string>>"]]}],"expect":{"method":"GET","target":"/","host":"h"}}])
check('random header coords', sent_of(doc), fp(action(0,0,'H',[(tok0+tok2, tok1)],False)))

# --- event and channel coordinates
etok = rand_token('s','event/0/data',0)
ctok = rand_token('s','channel/0/part/1/data',0)
doc = base(cases=[{"name":"a","frames":[{"Type":"data","data_to_transfered":"d","End_Stream":True}],"expect":{"method":"GET","target":"/","host":"h"}}],
           events=[{"at":1,"kind":"data","stream":0,"data":"<<random_string>>","end":True}],
           channels=[{"name":"e","parts":[{"case":"a","data":"p0"},{"case":"a","data":"<<random_string>>"}]}])
r = run(json.dumps(doc))
check('random event coord', r['cases'][0]['received'], fp(action(1,0,'d',etok.encode(),True)))
check('random channel coord', r['channels'][0]['bytes'], fp(b'p0'+ctok.encode()))
check('random channel owners', r['channels'][0]['requests'][0]['owners'], [['a',2+len(etok)]])

# --- markers inside an ordinary literal are not expressions
doc = base(cases=[{"name":"a","frames":[{"Type":"data","data_to_transfered":"a{{b'zz'}}c","End_Stream":True}],"expect":{"method":"GET","target":"/","host":"h"}}])
check('embedded markers literal', sent_of(doc), fp(b"a{{b'zz'}}c"))

# --- whole expression template
doc = base(definitions=[["p","b'abc'"],["q","p+p"],["r","q[1:5]"]],
           cases=[{"name":"a","frames":[{"Type":"data","data_to_transfered":"{{ r + p[0:1] }}","End_Stream":True}],"expect":{"method":"GET","target":"/","host":"h"}}])
check('expression template', sent_of(doc), fp(b'bca'+b'a'))

# --- unicode string literals encode to utf-8, slices are byte offsets
doc = base(definitions=[["u","'\u00e9\u00e9'"]],
           cases=[{"name":"a","frames":[{"Type":"data","data_to_transfered":"{{ u[1:3] }}","End_Stream":True}],"expect":{"method":"GET","target":"/","host":"h"}}])
check('utf8 slice', sent_of(doc), fp(b'\xa9\xc3'))

# --- repetition either order, zero repetition, empty sequence
doc = base(definitions=[["z","b''"],["w","(b'ab')*0"],["v","3*b'xy'"]],
           cases=[{"name":"a","frames":[{"Type":"data","data_to_transfered":"{{ v + w + z + b'!' }}","End_Stream":True}],"expect":{"method":"GET","target":"/","host":"h"}}])
check('repeat forms', sent_of(doc), fp(b'xyxyxy!'))

# --- invalid expressions all produce {"error":"input"}
bad_exprs = [
  "b'a'+1", "1+1", "b'a'*b'b'", "-b'a'", "b'a'[-1:]", "b'a'[::1]", "b'a'[0:1:1]",
  "unknown_name", "len(b'a')", "b'a'.upper()", "[b'a']", "b'{'a'\"}",
  "b'a' if True else b'b'", "lambda: b'a'", "b'a'+b'b' if 1 else b'c'",
  "b'a'*2*3",  # fine actually: (b'a'*2)*3
  "b'a' * -1", "b'a'[2:1]", "b'a'[0:9]", "f'b{x}'", "b'%s'%1", "{'a':1}",
  "(1,2)", "True", "None", "b'a';b'b'", "import os", "b'a' @ b'b'", "b'a'/2",
  "2*3", "b'a'+ 1.5", "b'a'*2**3", "b'a'[None:]",
]
for expr in bad_exprs:
    doc = base(definitions=[["d",expr]],
               cases=[{"name":"a","frames":[{"Type":"data","data_to_transfered":"{{d}}","End_Stream":True}],"expect":{"method":"GET","target":"/","host":"h"}}])
    got = run(json.dumps(doc))
    check('bad expr '+repr(expr), got, {"error":"input"} if expr!="b'a'*2*3" else None)

# valid: b'a'*2*3
doc = base(definitions=[["d","b'a'*2*3"]],
           cases=[{"name":"a","frames":[{"Type":"data","data_to_transfered":"{{d}}","End_Stream":True}],"expect":{"method":"GET","target":"/","host":"h"}}])
check('chained repeat', sent_of(doc), fp(b'a'*6))

# --- forward reference and integer-only definition are invalid
for expr in ["later", "7"]:
    doc = base(definitions=[["d",expr],["later","b'x'"]],
               cases=[{"name":"a","frames":[{"Type":"data","data_to_transfered":"{{d}}","End_Stream":True}],"expect":{"method":"GET","target":"/","host":"h"}}])
    check('bad def '+expr, run(json.dumps(doc)), {"error":"input"})

# --- keyword / bad identifier definition names
for name in ["class","2x","_x","x"*33,"a-b","None"]:
    doc = base(definitions=[[name,"b'x'"]],
               cases=[{"name":"a","frames":[{"Type":"data","data_to_transfered":"{{"+name+"}}","End_Stream":True}],"expect":{"method":"GET","target":"/","host":"h"}}])
    check('bad def name '+name, run(json.dumps(doc)), {"error":"input"})

# --- expression length / depth budgets
doc = base(definitions=[["d","b'x'"+"+b'x'"*4000]],
           cases=[{"name":"a","frames":[{"Type":"data","data_to_transfered":"{{d}}","End_Stream":True}],"expect":{"method":"GET","target":"/","host":"h"}}])
check('long expr ok', sent_of(doc), fp(b'x'*4001))
doc = base(definitions=[["d","b'x'"+"+b'x'"*4096]],
           cases=[{"name":"a","frames":[{"Type":"data","data_to_transfered":"{{d}}","End_Stream":True}],"expect":{"method":"GET","target":"/","host":"h"}}])
check('long expr rejected', run(json.dumps(doc)), {"error":"input"})

deep = "b'x'" + "[0:1]"*200
doc = base(definitions=[["d",deep]],
           cases=[{"name":"a","frames":[{"Type":"data","data_to_transfered":"{{d}}","End_Stream":True}],"expect":{"method":"GET","target":"/","host":"h"}}])
check('deep slice rejected', run(json.dumps(doc)), {"error":"input"})
deep = "b'x'" + "[0:1]"*120
doc = base(definitions=[["d",deep]],
           cases=[{"name":"a","frames":[{"Type":"data","data_to_transfered":"{{d}}","End_Stream":True}],"expect":{"method":"GET","target":"/","host":"h"}}])
check('deep slice accepted', sent_of(doc), fp(b'x'))

# --- oversized template source / huge repetition length
doc = base(cases=[{"name":"a","frames":[{"Type":"data","data_to_transfered":"q"*65537,"End_Stream":True}],"expect":{"method":"GET","target":"/","host":"h"}}])
check('template too long', run(json.dumps(doc)), {"error":"input"})
doc = base(definitions=[["d","b'x'*(2**63-1)"]])
check('huge repeat ok length', run(json.dumps(doc))['cases'], [])
doc = base(definitions=[["d","b'x'*(2**63)"]])
check('huge repeat overflow', run(json.dumps(doc)), {"error":"input"})

print('FAILURES:', len(failures))
PYEOF
